short: The decisive naval battle of the Peloponnesian War, where the Spartan fleet destroyed the Athenian navy.
full:
In 405 BCE, the Peloponnesian War was decided in the Hellespont, at the strait of Aegospotami. The Spartan commander Lysander, whose fleet was funded by Persian gold, caught the Athenian navy completely off guard while their ships were beached and the crews were foraging on shore. The Spartan attack was swift and devastating, capturing or destroying almost the entire Athenian fleet with virtually no resistance.

Without a fleet, Athens could no longer import grain from the Black Sea or maintain communication with its remaining empire. Lysander immediately sailed to Athens and blockaded the port of Piraeus, starving the city into submission the following year. The battle effectively ended the long and destructive Peloponnesian War.
